description: Choose a city and plan daily routes. Add another city when your trip takes you farther. Keep track of packing, expenses, check-ins and photos. Photos stay on your device. Optional AI title suggestions use event times and coordinates.
release_notes: Tap a planned stop on the results map to find sights or hotels nearby. Move the same search between cities on a travel day, including the city of a continuing stay or checkout. The day route stays available when a search returns no places.
